definitions.pace_100: Moving time per 100 m: the time spent swimming (rests excluded) ÷ the distance × 100.
definitions.swolf: SWOLF: seconds plus strokes for one length. Lower is more efficient; compare only in the same pool.
definitions.css_100: Critical swim speed per 100 m: (T400 − T200) ÷ 2, from this session's all-out 400 and 200.
definitions.pace_spread: How much the pace of a set's reps varied: standard deviation ÷ mean. Under 3 % is even.
definitions.run_spread: How much a circuit's run legs varied in time: standard deviation ÷ mean.
definitions.stray_laps: Laps under 10 s on a lap-button session: a button pressed twice, which shifts every step after it.

load.definition: Garmin training load: EPOC, from heart rate. It barely registers lifting — read strength by tonnage and sets, never with cardio in one number.

fuel_band.definition: Carbohydrate during a session, by its length, how hard it is and the sport. Under an hour: none. 60–90 min: none if easy, about 30 g/h if hard. 90 min to under 2.5 h: 30–60 g/h easy, about 60 hard. 2.5 h or more: 60–90 g/h of glucose and fructose. Runs take the lower half of each band; swims none. Sources: ACSM 2016; Jeukendrup 2014.

fuel_target.definition: The rate planned: the top of a hard session's band, the middle of an easy one's, never above what your gut is trained to (60 g/h until you say otherwise), plus 10 g/h on a gut-training session.

fuel_gut.definition: The most carbohydrate an hour you have taken in training without trouble. Raised 10 g/h at a time, only after a logged session at the current rate.

fuel_taken.definition: What you logged taking, in grams, from each product's label and your bottle recipe as it was that day. Self-reported: Garmin does not record it.

score.definition: How the session went against what was planned for it that day, 0–100. Execution, not fitness: heat, decoupling and efficiency stay flags. Each part scores 0–1 and earns its weight; a part that cannot be scored drops out and the others rescale. Under 60 % of the session scored, no total. 85+ As planned · 70–84 Mostly · 50–69 Partly · under 50 Off plan · under 60 % scored: Unclear. A gym session with a planned exercise not started scores 84 at most.

score_sets.definition: Working sets done ÷ planned, per exercise, capped at planned: extra sets add nothing.

score_reps.definition: Per planned set, reps (or seconds) done ÷ target, capped at 1. A per-side set is scored per side.

score_load.definition: Per planned set, the load in the program's terms (per hand, discs on a machine) ÷ the ask, capped at 1; on a weighted bodyweight lift, body plus plate. More than 15 % over is flagged, not rewarded; near double means suspect the implement. A lift done on a different machine is not comparable and drops out.

score_rest.definition: Share of rests between sets within 0.75–1.5 × the prescribed rest. Weighted low: rest runs on the lap button.

score_intent.definition: Easy and tempo rides: the share of time in the intent's band (power against your FTP, else the activity's own HR zones); 85 % scores full. On an easy ride, time under the band counts half. Interval rides: IF inside the intent's band.

score_intervals.definition: Only when the plan sets work: time at the target's low end −5 % or better (3-second power), held 20 s or more, ÷ the work planned.

score_duration.definition: Moving time against the plan, both ways: ±10 % scores full, ±50 % nothing.

score_pacing.definition: Steady rides: variability index, 1.05 or under full, 1.20 nothing. Runs: second half's pace within 3 % of the first. Not scored on interval rides.

score_fuel.definition: Only when a fuel plan existed: grams taken ÷ planned, capped at 1. A log with no grams drops out.

score_distance.definition: Metres swum against the metres planned, both ways: within 10 % scores full, 50 % off nothing.

score_swims.definition: Planned swims done, in order (the lap's distance matching the planned rep's) ÷ planned swims.

score_swim_pacing.definition: Per set of repeated swims, the spread of pace across its reps: 3 % or under full, 10 % nothing.

score_steps.definition: Working steps of the planned circuit done (a lap of its own, not a stray press) ÷ planned.

score_structure.definition: Laps against the planned steps: the same number scores full; each lap more or fewer costs its share. A stray lap press shifts every step after it.

score_circuit_pacing.definition: The spread of the run legs' times: 5 % or under full, 20 % nothing.
